title: Tamales de Flor de Calabaza (Squash Blossom Tamales)
origin: Migrated from Oaxaca Casa Crespo/Tamales de flor de calabaza.docx (file dated 2024-03-07)

steps.action: Beat on high until pale and fluffy:

items: 2 Tbsp dough in the center of each husk
Overlap the sides; fold the tip under

steps.action: Steam upright over boiling water, covered with a towel and lid, on high about 1 hr, until dough releases from the husk:
items: 2 coins in the steamer base rattle while water remains; add water when they go quiet

edits: Source method says "butter"; ingredient list says lard
